order_wins: **Ashoka Buildcon** — receives a **Rs 290.23 crore (incl. GST) Letter of Acceptance from North Eastern Railway** for traction substations on the Gorakhpur Cantt-Chhapra Gramin section, over 24 months _(~10.2% of mcap)_.
**Bajel Projects** — wins a **Major order (Rs 200-300 crore band, incl. GST) from Tata Power** for 220 kV GIS substations at Salsette and Powai, Mumbai _(~11.0% of mcap on the band floor)_.
**Brahmaputra Infrastructure** — its joint venture receives a **Rs 897.30 million Letter of Acceptance from Punjab PWD** for a 1,606-metre bridge over the Ravi, over 24 months _(~22.0% of mcap)_.
**LCC Projects** — receives a **Rs 62.32 crore (excl. GST) Letter of Commitment from Reliance Industries** for civil works of a 400 kV GIS substation at Jamnagar _(~1.5% of mcap)_.

**Shree TNB Polymers** — receives **three HDPE pipe orders worth Rs 50.99 crore (excl. GST)** for a Gujarat water project and Adani Electricity and Tata Power works, due by December _(~42.6% of mcap)_.

**Krystal Integrated Services** — receives a **Rs 25.99 crore (incl. GST) Letter of Acceptance from South East Central Railway** for on-board housekeeping in Bilaspur division trains _(~2.9% of mcap)_.
**Aptech** — wins an estimated **Rs 19.05 crore contract from an unnamed state government body** to run a computer-based examination in Q3 FY27 _(~3.9% of mcap)_.
**NIS Management** — subsidiary wins a **Rs 6.24 crore order** from CRM Enterprise Business for CCTV and ANPR surveillance across North Bengal police districts _(~7.7% of mcap)_.
**Happy Square Outsourcing** — receives a **Rs 3.20 crore work order from DRDO's Office of DG (MSS)** for services from October 2026 to March 2028 _(~7.3% of mcap)_.
**Subex** — wins a **USD 0.7 million deal** with a leading African mobile operator to deploy its HyperSense fraud-management software.

**Paradeep Parivahan** — wins a two-year JSW Cement road-transport contract from 1 November; with 100 planned bulkers it estimates about Rs 30 crore of extra annual revenue (contract value not stated).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **PTC Industries** — closes its QIP, allocating **8,54,700 shares at Rs 21,060**, a 4.92% discount to the Rs 22,150 floor, for **Rs 1,800 crore** (our arithmetic) _(~4.9% of mcap)_.
**Goblin India** — board approves a **rights issue of up to Rs 31.50 crore**; a rights committee will set price, ratio and record date _(~161% of mcap)_.
**CP Capital (formerly Career Point)** — board approves up to **16,45,000 warrants at Rs 152 to its promoter group (Rs 25 crore)**, subject to an EGM on 2 November _(~9.0% of mcap)_.
equity_allotments: **Datakosa (formerly Bodhtree Consulting)** — allots 20,58,822 new shares at Rs 17 to non-promoters Virello Estate and Nerdix Technologies for **Rs 3.50 crore**, received in full _(~12.9% of mcap)_.
**Quint Digital** — makes the first and final call of Rs 5 on its 82,61,401 partly paid rights warrants (**Rs 4.13 crore**), payable 6-20 November _(~1.6% of mcap)_.
m_and_a: **Persistent Systems** — its takeover offer secures about **94.04% of Nagarro**; it plans a squeeze-out of the minority and expects to close by the end of Q1 CY27.
**Tata Motors** — subsidiary TML CV Holdings raises its tender offer for Iveco Group to **EUR 14.40 a share (cum dividend) from EUR 14.10**, calling it its best and final offer.
**Mahindra & Mahindra** — Embraer agrees to buy 51% of step-down subsidiary Novavayu Aerospace, incorporated in July, for about **Rs 5.10 lakh**; it becomes an associate by 1 December.
**Inox Green Energy Services** — subsidiary Vibhav Energy converts **Rs 150 crore** of inter-corporate deposits into equity; Authum Investment takes 25% for its Rs 100 crore and Inox Green keeps 75%.
**Starlineps Enterprises** — completes the first tranche of its Rs 160 crore plan for 50% of Celloraa Energy, subscribing **33.33% for Rs 80 crore** _(~22.6% of mcap)_.
**Lodha Developers** — secured creditors and shareholders approve, at NCLT-convened meetings, the merger of Roselabs Finance and National Standard (India) into the company.
**Triveni Engineering & Industries** — demerged Triveni Power Transmission receives BSE and NSE listing and trading approval, trading from 12 October.
**Pavna Industries** — completes the sale of its 50.74% of subsidiary Swapnil Switches to promoter-group buyers for **Rs 2.53 crore** _(~1.2% of mcap)_.
**Felix Industries** — completes buying 84.34% of Tierra Fertilizer from Felix Prime Metals for about **Rs 1.69 crore**; after a fresh issue it holds 79.34%.
**Alok Industries** — a step-down subsidiary completes the sale of its entire stake in Mileta a.s., disclosed in December 2025; the filing gives no value.

**Frog Innovations** — signs a five-year agreement with US-based LigoWave Networks to make and sell its unlicensed-band radio products in India, with minimum annual purchase commitments (value not disclosed).
capex_core: **Federal-Mogul Goetze (India)** — board approves a **Rs 3,351 million capacity addition** in piston rings, pistons, valves, guides and seats at Patiala, Bengaluru and Bhiwadi within 18 months, from internal accruals _(~13.6% of mcap)_.
business_updates: **Results season** — 15 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Premier Energies** — wins **orders of Rs 4,001 crore in Q2 FY27** for 2,308 MW of solar cells and modules plus EPC work, excluding retail _(~9.8% of mcap)_.
**S H Kelkar and Company** — Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rises **15% YoY to Rs 632.7 crore** (provisional); net debt is Rs 911 crore.
**Kalpataru** — Q2 FY27 pre-sales fall **5% YoY to Rs 1,258 crore** while collections hold at Rs 1,189 crore; H1 pre-sales are flat at Rs 2,587 crore.
**Ajmera Realty & Infra** — Q2 FY27 sales value falls **69% YoY to Rs 224 crore** and collections 14% to Rs 190 crore; H1 sales value is Rs 370 crore.
**K. V. Toys India** — H1 FY27 revenue rises **27.70% YoY to Rs 102.74 crore** (management estimates); the board has approved buying 50% of Play Panda, subject to due diligence.
**Aaron Industries** — dispatches **19 EVOQ360 home lifts in Q2 FY27** and holds confirmed advance orders for about 60 units from 18 parties, for dispatch by December.
**Jash Engineering** — September consolidated order intake is **Rs 102 crore** (Rs 59 crore overseas), with the order book at Rs 944 crore on 1 October _(~2.9% of mcap)_.
**DEE Development Engineers** — September order inflow of **Rs 225.17 crore** and execution of Rs 129.74 crore lift the order book to Rs 2,531.04 crore.
**GeeCee Ventures** — the ITAT Mumbai quashes the AY 2017-18 reassessment that added **Rs 13.40 crore** to its income, holding the reopening notice invalid _(~1.9% of mcap)_.
**Rane Holdings** — a GST authority drops a **Rs 10.07 crore** input-tax-credit demand, including penalty, against subsidiary Rane Steering Systems for FY23 and FY24.
distress_risk: **Siemens Energy India** — Russia's Supreme Court rejects its appeal, leaving in force an arbitral order to pay **₹443.76 million (USD 5.17 million)** plus 8% interest; it will resist enforcement in India.
**Polycab India** — NCLAT stays the 7 October NCLT order admitting Asier Metals' insolvency petition over an alleged **Rs 2.79 crore** operational debt.

**SecUR Credentials Limited** — Members of the Exchange are hereby informed about the compulsory delisting of Equity Shares of SecUR Credentials Limited w.e.f. October 16, 2026 in terms of Regulation 32(1) of Securities and Exchange
credit_rating_changes: **The Indian Hotels Company** — CARE **upgrades its long-term bank facilities to AAA/Stable from AA+/Stable** and reaffirms A1+.
**HBL Engineering** — CARE **upgrades its long-term facilities to AA-/Stable from A+/Positive**, citing the shift to Kavach railway electronics.
**Mafatlal Industries** — CARE **upgrades its bank facilities to A-/Stable and A2+ from BBB+/Stable and A2**, citing growth in scale and liquidity.
**Embassy Developments** — Infomerics **upgrades its bank facilities to IVR A/Stable from IVR A-/Stable** and rates its Rs 160 crore NCDs IVR A.
**Cords Cable Industries** — CARE **upgrades its bank facilities to BBB+/Stable and A3+ from BBB/Stable and A3**.
**Themis Medicare** — CARE **downgrades its long-term facilities to BB+/Stable from BBB-/Negative** and short-term to A4+ from A3.
other_notable: **Emami** — closes its open-market buyback early, having bought 73 lakh shares at an average Rs 385.26 for **Rs 281.24 crore**, 99.73% of the Rs 282 crore maximum _(~1.7% of mcap)_.
